0.8.2 removes the experimental event-time indexer and changes nothing else: format epoch 4, the server's storage and protocol formats and the extension's formats (`USQ2`, `USS3`, `USL1`) are unchanged. 0.8.1 and 0.8.2 nodes run in one cluster during a rolling upgrade, and 0.8.1 and 0.8.2 owners and readers of one stream work side by side. Upgrade in place with an ordinary rolling restart (`helm upgrade`), with no fresh install or data move, once your values no longer set the indexer. Rolling back to 0.8.1 is safe.

- **The `indexer` role is gone.** `ursula indexer` fails at argument parsing, and the `ursula-index` crate is no longer built or published. Nothing in the server or the gateway depended on it.
- **Remove the indexer from your values before you upgrade.** The chart's values schema refuses the `indexer` block, `indexer.enabled: false` included, and the `deploymentContract.indexer*` keys, so `helm upgrade` to 0.8.2 fails while any of them is set. Turn the indexer off on 0.8.1 or earlier and roll that out, then delete the keys. Outside Helm, remove every process that runs `ursula indexer` first. The `ursula-chaos` chart drops `target.indexerUrl` and `target.indexSourceBaseUrl` the same way.
- **Event-time queries have no replacement.** Read a stream by offset, and keep an index in your application if you need lookups by event time, for example a SQLite database replicated through Ursula with `@tonbo/sqlite-ursula`.
- **The indexer's S3 prefix and IAM role are unused after the upgrade**, so you can delete both.

Known issues: the known issues of 0.8.1, [#411](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/411), [#461](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/461), [#465](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/465), [#496](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/496), [#517](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/517), [#518](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/518), [#539](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/539), [#561](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/561), [#687](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/687), [#698](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/698) and [#709](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/709), are unchanged. Every change is listed in the [0.8.2 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#082).
